worldcombat.skill.dig.summary: Carves a short passage through natural soil: dive, crawl forward underground and erupt at the chosen point, routing around surface obstacles. The surfacing flings the first foe the body actually sweeps and deals one physical hit. The passage is only carved through natural soil/stone; if the precheck fails (building blocks, ores, water/lava, too far or too large) the move does not fire and the user never blinks across. The point is locked during preparation, so a moving target can walk out.
worldcombat.skill.dig.use.0: Burrow past surface obstacles to flank
worldcombat.skill.dig.use.2: Reach a ranged foe over a low wall
worldcombat.skill.dig.description.0: The surfacing sweep deals about %1$s physical damage; it settles only on the first hostile body the body actually sweeps, with no area damage.
worldcombat.skill.dig.description.1: Diving, crawling and surfacing take about %1$s ticks in total; higher Speed shortens it. This window is the target's chance to walk away or brace.
worldcombat.skill.dig.description.motion: This move does not pick an enemy: choose a landing point within %1$s blocks, dive underground and move there to erupt; the surfacing flings the swept target upward about %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dig.description.2: The passage is a set of real air cells that exists briefly in the world: it is only carved through natural soil/stone, at most 64 cells and no more than 8 blocks horizontally; building blocks, ores, water/lava and block-entity blocks all fail the precheck and the move does not fire. When the action ends or is interrupted the original blocks return, and cells a living body occupies postpone restoration until it leaves; no lasting pit is left.
worldcombat.skill.dig.description.3: Ambush is on: a longer preparation and cooldown for a stronger surfacing hit and a higher launch; the point and passage check are unchanged.
worldcombat.skill.dig.description.4: Ambush is off: a shorter preparation and cooldown at base surfacing power and launch.
worldcombat.skill.dig.description.5: The passage precheck is read-only: it checks whether the body can sweep through and whether both ends have a natural soil roof. When it fails the move simply refuses instead of teleporting.
worldcombat.skill.dig.timing: Prepare %1$s s, recover %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.dig.growth.0: From level 25 the surfacing power climbs another step with level.
worldcombat.skill.dig.growth.1: From level 50 the surfacing power climbs one more step.
On: spend 6 more ticks preparing for a stronger surfacing hit and a higher launch on a longer cooldown. Off: a faster cast on a shorter cooldown at base values.
worldcombat.skill.dig.preference.ai.open: Only on held targets keeps the dig for rooted, paralysed or non-fleeing foes; digging at a runner usually misses. When the passage precheck fails the move never fires.
worldcombat.skill.dig.preference.ai.crow: Only dig when at least this many enemies cluster near the target; 1 digs at a lone target.
worldcombat.skill.dig.preference.ai.maxC: Only consider digging when the target is within this distance.
